## Design notes

Generated by tools/gen-linked-meta.sh; do not edit. Each bodied
`meta` definition of lib/meta.x and of the imported `.xmacro`
files appears here without its `meta` marker, so it runs as
native code instead of through the Lisp lowering.
`Compiler.bind_linked_meta` binds an imported definition to its
copy only when the two texts hash the same, so a compiler built
before a `.xmacro` edit stages the edited definition. The
lib/meta.x builders with a run-time form bind to the runtime's
own definitions and have no copy here.
